title: Refine Workers tab evidence-first UX
summary: Refined the Workers tab into an evidence-first distributed controls surface with clearer saved-config, persisted-state, readiness, lifecycle-boundary, and route-contract language.
reason: Operators need to understand standalone, coordinator, and worker modes without mistaking saved settings or persisted evidence for live lifecycle controls. The tab must also prove lifecycle mutation routes are absent until backend-owned commands exist.
behavior_before: The Workers tab led with mode status and settings, then readiness and worker state. Labels such as Role, Worker State, Worker Progress, and Worker Mode Settings could blur saved configuration, persisted runtime evidence, and live control state. Lifecycle and API contract evidence were mostly advanced-only.
behavior_after: The Workers tab leads with Mode Summary, Mode Model, Readiness + Lifecycle Boundary, compact Workers route summary, Persisted Worker State, Last Reported Worker Progress, Saved Worker Mode Settings, Network Config, Open History, and Advanced evidence panels. Settings are framed as staged saved config only, persisted worker state is labeled as read-only evidence, and lifecycle mutation controls remain absent.
rollback_plan: Revert the Workers tab partial, Network view asset, Network settings builder copy, updated WebView tests, generated summaries, and this change packet. Rerun the WebView Network read-only boundary test and npm webview asset check after rollback.
notes: No coordinator/worker start, stop, retry, reclaim, release, abort, publish, drain, rename, state-write, or media mutation controls were added.
